# Liubov Pohudina — Full Stack Developer & AI Automation Engineer

This website is the professional portfolio of Liubov Pohudina, a Full Stack Developer and AI Automation Engineer.

The portfolio presents selected commercial, full-stack, frontend, backend, and AI automation projects, professional experience, technical skills, and contact information.

## About

Liubov Pohudina specializes in building modern web applications, full-stack solutions, AI-powered automation systems, and business integrations.

Core areas of expertise include:

- Frontend development with React and TypeScript
- Backend development with Node.js
- Full-stack application development
- AI automation and AI agents
- n8n workflow automation
- REST API integrations
- Webhooks and third-party services
- SEO and web performance optimization
- Analytics and production deployment

## Selected Projects

The portfolio includes projects such as:

- AI Audio Processing & Automation System
- Renovation Business Website
- TaskPro
- AquaTrack
- BrushBuddy
- Food Boutique

Detailed project case studies are available in the Projects section of the website.

## Technologies

React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Redux, Redux Toolkit, Node.js, MongoDB, Material UI, styled-components, n8n, AI Agents, OpenAI APIs, REST APIs, Webhooks, Swagger, Cloudflare, Google Analytics, Google Sheets, Web3Forms, and related web technologies.
